rights_note: LOC rights advisory: 'No known restrictions on publication.' Used only as a reference picture people are judged against (T-3417); nothing is traced or sampled from it.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-06 (T-3417). A period illustrator's drawing of a brougham coachman: a pale blue double-breasted livery coat with two rows of buttons, a dark collar, a white stock, a tall hat with a cockade band, pale gloves holding reins and a long whip upright, light breeches and top boots, sitting upright with knees high on the box cushion. Undated within Penfield's working life; it is a drawing, so its folds and colours are the artist's, not a camera's.
note: One of the 1904 coachman reference set's pictures (data/humans/reference_sets/coachman_1904.json). The only colour picture in the set; its blue livery is one household's choice, not a rule.
what_it_supplies: a brougham coachman's whole figure, box and horse from the front quarter
how the coat, hat and gloves sit together in colour
the upright, high-kneed seat on a brougham box
